public_reply_templates.label: Standard — most common
public_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for info, contact, consultation, treatments, website, or how to reach SPA 312
public_reply_templates.template:
Of course! Here's everything you need ✨

🌐 [CAMPAIGN URL]
📞 Call or text: [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER]
📍 SPA 312 Chicago
💬 FREE consultation available

Quick question — are you interested in face, body, or both? We can guide you from there 🌿
notes: Free consultation is the main conversion hook for SPA 312
Asks only one soft qualifier: face/body/both
Does not reveal private owner cell publicly
Works for English posts; if the original post is Spanish, use the Spanish equivalent with the same structure

public_reply_templates.label: Short version — when they just say 'interested!'
public_reply_templates.template: Love that ✨ We offer a FREE consultation at SPA 312 Chicago so we can understand your goals first. Are you thinking face, body, or both?
notes: Consultation-first instead of selling treatment immediately

public_reply_templates.label: When they say 'DM me' or 'Message me'
public_reply_templates.trigger: They explicitly ask to be contacted privately
public_reply_templates.template: Will do! Sending you a message now ✨ We can also help you schedule a FREE consultation at SPA 312 Chicago if that works better.
notes: Bot should send DM with full SPA 312 consultation message
Use Spanish version when the prospect wrote in Spanish
